boundary: This classifies the natural global finite-group correspondence.  It does not deny the local abstract K4,4 frame quotient; it tests whether that local K3,3 can be promoted canonically to a small subset of the distinct 360 chart-graph K3,3 witnesses.
theorem: The complete PSp(4,3) packet-by-global-K3,3 relation is classified by the packet stabilizer. Any equivariant witness assignment must be a union of the listed stabilizer orbits. Therefore the local K4,4 -> S4/V4 -> K3,3 quotient is not identified with eight selected members of the 360 global Schlaefli K3,3 shell unless cardinality eight is a stabilizer-orbit union.
